detailed_descriptions.en: "Azure Striker Gunvolt GX" adds a new mode featuring Copen, protagonist of the spin-off Luminous Avenger iX 2, fighting alongside Gunvolt. *Story* The Primal Dragon, "Gunvolt". At once the pinnacle of humanity's evolution, and the harbinger of its demise... In order to prevent the "future of destruction" that Gunvolt threatens, I had to intervene with time itself. I kept exploring new possibilities, crossing timelines over and over again. When, here, at long last... I finally found a glimmer of hope. So begins... My final intervention. May the tomorrow we dreamed of become today's reality. ①Complete new story with full voice acting! Experience an all-new, exclusive story in the Gunvolt timeline starting from the mystery of Xiao Wu, Gunvolt's old friend and comrade. Featuring full English and Japanese voice acting! ②Copen and GV work together with the "Inspiration" system! Gunvolt GX features a tag-team of Copen and GV as playable characters, leaving you to choose how to tackle mission with the two. While one is fighting, the other on standby will gain "Inspiration". Tag between them while Inspiration is full and you'll gain a temporary boost, making the powerful fighters even stronger. Swapping out with high Inspiration will also fill your "GX Skill" gauge, allowing you to unleash a devastating tag attack when full. ③Defeat bosses to gain new EX Weapons and Skills! As Copen and GV team up to defeat the bosses, they'll also share the rewards. Copen gets a new EX Weapon for each boss you defeat, and GV will awaken a new Skill. Copen's EX Weapons are all-new for Gunvolt GX, opening up new strategies as you take on its challenges. ④Two Muses heat up battle with a duet! Clear 1000 Kudos and GV's "Muse" Lumen, or Copen's "Muse of Hope" Lola will amp up the battle with song. But when the muses sing together, their song will transform. Keep earning Kudos and their song will further change! ⑤Earn rewards for leveling up, plus more replayability! Gain EXP and raise the heroes' level to earn more health and new ability slots. Buy new abilities with credits and equip them to further power up. After finishing the main story, you'll unlock challenging special missions to take on with your full power Copen and GV!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
"Azure Striker Gunvolt GX" adds a new mode featuring Copen, protagonist of the spin-off Luminous Avenger iX 2, fighting alongside Gunvolt.

　

*Story*

The Primal Dragon, "Gunvolt".

At once the pinnacle of humanity's evolution, and the harbinger of its demise...

In order to prevent the "future of destruction" that Gunvolt threatens, I had to intervene with time itself.

I kept exploring new possibilities, crossing timelines over and over again.

When, here, at long last...

I finally found a glimmer of hope.

So begins...

My final intervention.

May the tomorrow we dreamed of become today's reality.

　

①Complete new story with full voice acting!

Experience an all-new, exclusive story in the Gunvolt timeline starting from the mystery of Xiao Wu, Gunvolt's old friend and comrade.

Featuring full English and Japanese voice acting!

　

②Copen and GV work together with the "Inspiration" system!

Gunvolt GX features a tag-team of Copen and GV as playable characters, leaving you to choose how to tackle mission with the two.

While one is fighting, the other on standby will gain "Inspiration".

Tag between them while Inspiration is full and you'll gain a temporary boost, making the powerful fighters even stronger.

Swapping out with high Inspiration will also fill your "GX Skill" gauge, allowing you to unleash a devastating tag attack when full.

　

③Defeat bosses to gain new EX Weapons and Skills!

As Copen and GV team up to defeat the bosses, they'll also share the rewards.

Copen gets a new EX Weapon for each boss you defeat, and GV will awaken a new Skill.

Copen's EX Weapons are all-new for Gunvolt GX, opening up new strategies as you take on its challenges.

　

④Two Muses heat up battle with a duet!

Clear 1000 Kudos and GV's "Muse" Lumen, or Copen's "Muse of Hope" Lola will amp up the battle with song.

But when the muses sing together, their song will transform.

Keep earning Kudos and their song will further change!

　

⑤Earn rewards for leveling up, plus more replayability!

Gain EXP and raise the heroes' level to earn more health and new ability slots.

Buy new abilities with credits and equip them to further power up.

After finishing the main story, you'll unlock challenging special missions to take on with your full power Copen and GV!
